steps.content: The night has fallen, and the weary people drag their heavy bodies back to their homes.
They don't want to think about anything, emptying their minds and bodies as they collapse on the sofa, numbly scrolling their phones for anything fun.
Until suddenly, a cyan light imprints itself on their eyeballs.
Black English letters paired with numbers and symbols, a small cute manta ray swims around them. It's just an ordinary webpage, but it inexplicably makes people want to tap into it.
When hesitating, a voice comes from the webpage.

steps.speaker: Guests
steps.content: Welcome to... Elysiland?
Ah, a sallow face, a numb body, dead eyes... you look like a dried salted fish. It's really heartbreaking, you weren't like this before.
How long has it been since something caught your eye? How long has it been since your heart raced?
When was the last time you felt truly satisfied?
Can't remember? Sigh... I know, life has let you down. Stagnant days and rigid rules, we're all trapped in this concrete jungle of reality, with our passion stolen away.
Have you ever thought about escaping? Even just a little, relaxing just a bit, kicking off the shackles, and taking a deep breath of fresh air.
If I told you there's a sea out there, a place of true freedom, would you want to come? Do you want to meet the real self... within you?
Just for a while, do you want to meet the real self in your heart that's been suppressed for so long?
Although it looks like a flashy and boring ad, those who know the true nature behind this immediately jump out of bed, rush to their computer desk, and log onto the forum.

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 1
steps.content: !!! Holy ****!! I got the Elysiland invitation link people keep talking about!!!

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 5
steps.content: "For real? I'll give you 50,000,000 DisCoins, let me have it!"

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 2
steps.content: "Can confirm, I am his psychiatrist, I sent the link to him."

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 3
steps.content: "Elysiland? Isn't it just a forum? Why so excited?"

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 2
steps.content: "Type 1 and I'll send it to you."

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 3
steps.content: "Really? So exciting, 11111."

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 2
steps.content: "LOL the posts in Elysiland are all wild and surreal, some are even extremely graphic, it is indeed quite thrilling."

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 4
steps.content: "Which version are you still on? The forum admin created a virtual platform a long time ago and has been randomly inviting people to join."
Yes, I can see it, a grand banquet is being held in your heart, yearning to expose everything!
What do you want to eat? What do you want to play? What kind of beauties or handsome guys do you want, what hero do you want to be, and what bad things do you want to do?
What gives you the adrenaline rush? What makes you think of... the charming scent of dopamine?
Do you have the image in your mind? Yes, that's the real you! The passion you have now is real, life is all about desire!

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 3
steps.content: "That's all fake, right? It's just an online post, you can write whatever you want. No matter how exaggerated, it's just online boasting, isn't it? What's the difference from those bragging brats?"

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 3
steps.content: "...Wait, I remember seeing many posts on the Elysiland forum, all about unspeakable secret desires... Could it be that the admin recreated the graphic scenarios from the posts...?"

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 4
steps.content: "Hahaha, why else would Elysiland have its name? It's the dark web, nothing is strange here."

People recall the posts from back then, describing how thrilling the "cannibal feast" was, with the aroma of food mingling with the sweet scent of roses and the stench of flesh. Instantly, their hearts race, and their eyes get closer to the screen, as if hoping to penetrate into a scene more joyful than that feast.

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 5
steps.content: "...Man, I kinda want to go."

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 6
steps.content: "Same."

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 7
steps.content: "Indeed, good luck, get ready to say goodbye to this world."

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 4
steps.content: "Hmm?! Bro, any juicy details? Tell us more. I'm all ears!"
Their hands are gently held, like being surrounded by sun-bathed seawater, warm, with a bit of humidity.
No matter how hard they blink, they can't see the face of the person holding their hand.
They can only vaguely see the corners of her smiling mouth, repeating these words—
Don't care about what others say, or whether these things are achievable, don't trap yourself, and trust your heart.
Only those with a beast in their heart can hear my voice. And I, invite you to a new world, to be your own king.
Even if just for a day, break through the cage, embrace the entire sea. Come on, right here—

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 7
steps.content: "I heard some people who entered Elysiland never came out again... why else do you think there are only 'legends' of Elysiland now?"

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 3
steps.content: "Isn't it just a forum? Is it that dangerous?"

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 7
steps.content: "What's there to worry about? The worst is just death, which is just the same end for all of us anyway lol. Moreover, those who went and never came back, they all..."

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 4
steps.content: "They all what? Don't keep me in suspense!"

steps.speaker: Dark Web User 7
steps.content: "They all died happily, haha! RIP!!"
We accommodate all desires here. And we will filter out everything you don't like. All you can see here will be the things you want the most, so... Click to agree and enter your own sea!

In rooms filled with wants and desires, people collapse on the table and fall into the sweetest dream. With a mouse in their hand, a computer in front of them, and the webpage they just clicked on, loading for a moment, and then disappears.
The computer screen only leaves a seemingly calm sea and a small fish swimming quietly.

The moment their consciousnesses reconnect, colors explode like fireworks before their eyes. No more concrete jungles, now they are surrounded by vibrant islands, and the unfamiliar scenery impacts them directly. Everyone is left speechless.
Blue waves crash against the rocks with a splash, and the staff in tight swimsuits on the beach wave at everyone. Only then do they come back to their senses.

steps.speaker: Guests
steps.content:
Look! It's the sea!
Ahoy! It's really the sea!
Am I really at the beach?
That's right! The blue skies and seas are all yours! I knew you would come!
The waves around the beach roar, and in the next instant, a tidal wave rises, exploding at its peak and sprinkling like raindrops on people's faces.
A young girl appears within the wall of waves, looking down at everyone through the clear seawater.

steps.speaker: Blue-Haired Girl
steps.content: Hello hello! Friends who are chasing pleasure, you have taken the brave first step, breaking free from restraints and embracing freedom. Now, it's time for your reward!

steps.speaker: Blue-Haired Girl
steps.content: Enjoy to your heart's content! Your passion is my passion, your joy is my joy!

steps.speaker: Blue-Haired Girl
steps.content: This is created just for you by the adorable and omnipotent <color=#fb9259>+\L.L/+</color>—

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Welcome to Elysiland</color>!!!
